packageRules.description: One weekly PR for all Rust patch and minor bumps. Cargo's semver discipline plus the workspace tests are enough signal to review them as a batch. Majors stay manual.
Pin every GitHub Action to a commit SHA so a moved tag cannot re-point CI at different code. Renovate refreshes the SHA on tagged releases.
All GitHub Actions bumps in one weekly PR. With SHA pinning this is mostly digest refreshes.
